text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Today's outing was great! All that's left
to do now
is head back to the academy
and get some rest...

text_block_list.name: Old Man
text_block_list.text:
We barely get any customers! How are
we
supposed to revitalize this old inn?!

text_block_list.name: Old Lady
text_block_list.text:
You only just took over! Don't throw in
the towel
so fast! There's a lot of history
here, you know.
You should take good
care of this place!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Are you struggling with something? I'd
be happy
to lend you an ear!

text_block_list.name: Old Man
text_block_list.text:
...And so, I'm thinking about closing
down my
parents' inn. Sure there's a
history there, but it's
run-down and
nobody comes to stay there
anymore...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
An inn that has to be closed down due
to a lack
of customers... that's also a
precious building you
inherited from
your parents...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Um! Could you show me the inn?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: I see... So this is the entrance...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: I knew it! It's filthy!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
But the entrance is where you invite the
god of
fortune in! You can't extend an
invitation when
it's in this state!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
But the direction's not bad, y'know. This
place has
the right qualities to bring in
all the good luck it
needs! Okay, let's
use feng shui to revive this inn!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, we're giving this all we've got!
Roll up
your sleeves and put on your
work gloves!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Let's sweep out all the dust and bad
qi. ♪ We can
swish-swish it all away! ♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oooh! You can see the color of the floor
again!
Hi there! How are you? How does
it feel to
breathe again?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Sooo, if we look at the floor layout
first... Okay,
let's move this dresser! Oh,
and that dressing
table! And then...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Of course there is! We have to be
thorough if
we're going to get the good
qi flowing! ☆ So go,
go, goooo!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Once we're done with this, let's go
shopping! We
have to get some new
decorations!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hm... The floor creaks when you walk on
it... We
might need a hammer and some
nails too.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Dad. Can you call a carpenter for
me?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! If we're going to do this, we might
as well
do it right! And you can just hear
the hallway
crying out in pain!
choice_data_list: Going all out to that extent!?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We make steady progress using both
feng shui
and physical strength...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Phew. So, how's it look? It's a big
improvement,
right?

text_block_list.name: Old Man
text_block_list.text: Wow... It's like a brand-new inn!

text_block_list.name: Old Lady
text_block_list.text:
Yes, and the atmosphere's wonderful!
It's like the
place has been completely
reborn!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
We just did a little cleaning is all! I also
arranged
everything in line with feng
shui, so things should
start getting real
happy around here!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The building's happy! ☆ You're both
lucky! ☆
Don't you think that's
wonderful?

text_block_list.name: Old Man
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm. Yeah. You're right! You've done
so much
to restore this inn—there's no
way I'm going to let
it close down on my
watch!

text_block_list.name: Old Man
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. This precious inn has been in
the
family for generations, and I'm going
to do my
best to revitalize it!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: You're very welcome!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: My goal is to make everyone happy with feng shui! If you give me a shot to do that, I'll do the best I can!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Well, I've been watching my dad
for years!
I'm glad I got to put
everything I learned from him
to use!
choice_data_list: It was worth the effort... it really was...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Still... a professional, though?! Hehe.
That has a
nice ring to it! Hehehe!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She might have been a little intense, but
it looks
like her encouraging personality
has made people
happy. I hope she can
keep showcasing the full
extent of her
skills.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Oh, did all that tire you out? I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Well, that's a relief! I feel the same!
choice_data_list: Still, it's a good kind of tired.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The tiredness you feel after helping
people is the
best!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She might have been a little intense, but
it looks
like her encouraging personality
has made people
happy. I hope she can
keep showcasing the full
extent of her
skills.
